spec.title: Add oxlint and rules to repository root
spec.context: The repository currently lacks a fast JavaScript/TypeScript linter. No oxlint configuration exists at the repo root, leaving code quality enforcement without rapid feedback. Adding oxlint provides significantly faster lint feedback than ESLint, consistent code quality enforcement across the project, and early detection of bugs and anti-patterns during development.

in-scope.item: Create .oxlintrc.json at the repository root with rules mapped from the provided ESLint configuration
Install oxlint as a root devDependency
Add a lint script to the root package.json
Add a lint task to turbo.json
Remove the non-functional eslint lint script from apps/vscode/package.json
Map all supported ESLint rules to oxlint equivalents

out-of-scope.item: Fixing any lint violations found by the new configuration
Rules not supported by oxlint (perfectionist/sort-classes, tsdoc/syntax)

requirements.requirement: An .oxlintrc.json configuration file shall exist at the repository root with a $schema reference for editor support
The configuration shall enable the eslint, typescript, and import built-in plugins
The configuration shall set ignorePatterns for node_modules, dist, .turbo, coverage, and scripts directories
The configuration shall enable the correctness category as the baseline

The configuration shall map the following ESLint rules to oxlint equivalents: - eslint/sort-imports: warn - typescript/no-useless-constructor: off - typescript/no-extraneous-class: off - typescript/no-non-null-assertion: off - typescript/no-dynamic-delete: off - typescript/no-explicit-any: off - typescript/no-empty-object-type: off - typescript/no-unused-vars: error (with argsIgnorePattern: ^_, varsIgnorePattern: ^_) - eslint/no-empty-pattern: off
The root package.json shall have oxlint installed as a devDependency
The root package.json shall have a "lint": "oxlint" script
turbo.json shall include a lint task definition
The non-functional "lint": "eslint src --ext ts" script shall be removed from apps/vscode/package.json
Running oxlint from the repo root shall lint both apps/vscode/src and apps/festinalente/src without configuration errors

file.reason: Root oxlint configuration file with rules mapped from ESLint config
Add oxlint devDependency and lint script

codebase.finding: pnpm workspace with apps/vscode and apps/festinalente packages, turbo for build orchestration
Shared TypeScript config with strict mode, ES2023 target — similar pattern for shared oxlint config at root
Non-functional "lint": "eslint src --ext ts" — no .eslintrc file exists, script is dead code

pitfall.issue: No existing ESLint config in repo
pitfall.mitigation: User provided ESLint flat config as reference for rule mapping
perfectionist/sort-classes and tsdoc/syntax have no oxlint equivalents — skip these rules, use eslint/sort-imports as partial replacement for perfectionist/sort-imports
Use ignorePatterns to exclude node_modules, dist, .turbo, coverage, and scripts directories
Remove the non-functional lint script from apps/vscode/package.json

constraints.constraint: Oxlint supports 43/59 typescript-eslint rules — some strict config rules may not have oxlint equivalents
perfectionist and tsdoc ESLint plugins are not available as built-in oxlint plugins
Config file must be .oxlintrc.json format (JSON, not JS/TS flat config)

risk.mitigation: Run oxlint after configuration to identify and address any issues

risks.risk: Some typescript-eslint strict rules may not be available in oxlint, resulting in fewer checks than the ESLint equivalent

risk.mitigation: Lint violations are out of scope for this task — fix separately

risks.risk: Existing code may have lint violations that surface when oxlint is first configured
